title: Life on Mars? — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
tonalCenter: F major moving to Bb major
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “Life on Mars?”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Verse A: F | Am | F7 | D7 | Gm | Bb | C7 | F (repeat 2×)
Verse B: F | Am | F7 | D7 | Gm | Bb | C7 | F (repeat 1×)
Pre-chorus: Ab | Db | Fm | Ab7 | Db | Bbm | Ab | C7 (repeat 2×)
Chorus: Bb | Eb | Gm | F | Bb | Eb | Gm | C7 (repeat 2×)
Instrumental turnaround: F | D7 | Gm | Bbm (repeat 1×)
Verse reprise: F | Am | F7 | D7 | Gm | Bb | C7 | F (repeat 2×)
Chorus reprise: Bb | Eb | Gm | F | Bb | Eb | C7 | Bb (repeat 2×)
Coda: Bb | Eb | Ebm | Bb (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Chromatic harmonies, piano-derived cadence and the shift toward Bb major for the chorus; chord symbols omit low bass inversions.
Score section map: Verse A (1–16) · Verse B (17–24) · Pre-chorus (25–40) · Chorus (41–56) · Instrumental turnaround (57–60) · Verse reprise (61–76) · Chorus reprise (77–92) · Coda (93–96).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://mtosmt.org/issues/mto.17.23.4/mto.17.23.4.ferrandino.html
